meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed the Monitoring and Enterprise templates against the agent evidence and runtime guides. The reference label is display-only, and model, tool, feedback and audit evidence remain role-scoped.

auth.review_note: Compared the profile rendering and saved HTTPS picture check to the authentication module guide. The guide documents the photo loading and JavaScript fallback cases.

commerce.review_note: Compared canonical optional fields, verified payment snapshots, historical flags, HSN groups and CSV review aggregation with the GST commerce guide.

content.review_note: Reviewed published Markdown guides, search navigation and module filters against the merged catalogue and account source.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed the reference-profile label and neutral fallback against the white-label and private presentation boundaries. The label is outside public profile fields and the existing authentication paths remain authoritative.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed Site analytics links against the dashboard, Google reporting, PageSpeed and Integration instructions. Connection setup and established permission and error states remain on their current routes.

http-errors.review_note: Compared the layout-specific title assignment with the request-error boundary. Website error status, sanitized error text and public not-found rendering follow their existing handlers.

interface.review_note: Reviewed the reconciled Design and interface guide against both release diffs. The analytics navigation is grouped by use, and dashboard labels, ownership, narrow layout, and unavailable states follow the current interface.

mail.review_note: Checked the two changed AdminController rendering paths against owner email and delivery-state guidance. Queue and mailbox behavior continues through the existing mail actions.

mcp-clients.review_note: Compared the Site analytics entry point in the Integrations guide with the local MCP grant and management page. Setup remains governed by the existing owner forms.

media.review_note: Reviewed the owner skill changes against media selection, deletion and metadata guidance. The new analytics section describes navigation and owner counts, and the media controls follow their documented path.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed the dashboard, site analytics destinations and Enterprise workspace against the operator help. Owners now see separate navigation for provider and quality evidence, traffic and search, and recorded commerce actions.

public-mcp.review_note: Cross-checked the updated route associations with Public MCP and A2UI guidance. The moved storefront evidence is rendered through the authenticated Dashboard and the published contracts stay scoped.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed Commerce overview and report links in Design against existing lifecycle, authority and payment documentation. Storefront action counts keep the same data and fixed window, and remote checkout contracts are unchanged.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed SettingsService module resolution and Merchant feed guidance. Dropping a retired header slot leaves the saved catalog eligibility inputs intact.

workflow.review_note: Verified current workflow guidance, including the newly released credential history fallback, against the analytics change and existing release tests. The separate Agent and Site sections use the existing approval and private test process.
